text: {"findings":[{"resource_address":"azurerm_network_security_rule.ssh","doc_id":"POL-002","attribute":"source_address_prefix","title":"The inbound rule allows SSH from the internet because \"source_address_prefix\" is \"0.0.0.0/1\", which is a public range wide enough to cover the internet and exposes port 22.","suggestion":"Restrict the source to a private network or bastion host range instead of a public CIDR.","breaks_standard":true}]}
